Package com.hamsaye.chat.users.services

Class UserServiceManagement

java.lang.Object
com.hamsaye.chat.users.services.UserServiceManagement
@Service public class UserServiceManagement extends Object
Service for managing user-related operations including disconnecting users and retrieving user information.

This service interacts with the UserService for user data access, the UserMapper for mapping entities to responses, and the UserProducerService for sending notifications about user events.

Version:

  • Method Details

    • disconnectUser

      public UserResponse disconnectUser(UUID uid, String socketId)
      Disconnects a user and sends a notification about the disconnection event.

      This method updates the user's connection state to disconnected and sends a notification message via the Kafka producer service.

      Parameters:
      uid - the UUID of the user to disconnect
      socketId - the WebSocket session ID of the user
      Returns:
      a UserResponse representing the updated state of the user
      Since:
      1.0
